about: Synthetic cases for experience-flags.py, both ways: each `flag` case must flag its `shape`, each `spare` case must flag nothing. Invented text only; no writer's real notes. Kept apart from tell-cases.json so a hook's cases arrive with its own change.
notes:
## Working thesis
The rota failed because nobody owned it.
## Evidence
- I stayed late on Monday to fix the rota.
- Last winter the boiler failed twice in one week.

cases.draft: I stood in the car park and watched the rain drip off the shelter.
We argued about the biscuits for an hour.
The office smelled of burnt toast all week.
Two summers ago the lift stopped between floors.
Plot twist: nobody had read the rota.
Spoiler: it did not go well.
On Monday I stayed late to fix the rota.
The boiler failed twice in one week last winter.
I walked in that morning and [ASK THE WRITER: what did you see?]
We lost a third of the orders [NEEDS SOURCE: the figure].
Teams ship faster with fewer meetings.
We think the rota should belong to one person.
You will have seen a rota fail before.
He told me, "I was late last week and the rota failed."

## I remember the rota
> Last year I stood in the car park.
We need a rota that one person owns.
